description: Source code for window management and rendering functions in a Lua-C binding context, including window creation, saving window content as images, and frame rate control.

methods.name: createWindow
methods.description: Creates a new window with specified width, height, and optional depth mode, sets global window object.

methods.name: saveWindow
methods.description: Captures the current window content and saves it as an image file (PNG, BMP, JPG) based on file extension.

methods.name: frameRate
methods.description: Gets or sets the target frame rate for rendering.

methods.name: lu5_update_window_size
methods.description: Updates the global window size variables and internal state.
